name: Immsi S.p.A.
summary: Immsi S.p.A. operates in the real estate, industrial, and naval sectors in Italy, the rest of Europe, India, the United States, and internationally. The company engages in the production and distribution of scooters, motorcycles, and light commercial vehicles; real estate development projects; Is Molas tourist hotel complex management; and production of defense ships, such as mine countermeasure vessels, fast patrol boats, hydrofoils, and fast ferries. It also offers two-wheeler vehicles under the Aprilia, Derbi, Gilera, Moto Guzzi, Piaggio, Scarabeo, and Vespa brand names; and commercial vehicles under the Ape brand names.
